description.value: The Wolf's Den is a full-service dinner restaurant housed in a large historic log building near the banks of the Kicking Horse River in Golden, BC, offering sweeping 180-degree mountain views. It specializes in AAA certified Angus steaks and an extensive homemade burger menu, with Golden's largest selection of cold beer on tap alongside a BC wine list and craft cocktails. The restaurant hosts weekly Sunday live jams and operates a summer patio, making it a lively evening destination in a mountain town popular with cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content for thewolfsdengolden.ca is fully fetched and confirms the name, address (1105 9th Street South, Golden, BC), and phone (250.344.9863) not present in OSM tags. The homepage explicitly states 'many vegetarian options,' confirming that amenity. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, takeout, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific infrastructure appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM tags contain no address or phone; both were sourced solely from the website — contact_confirmed fields left null as there is nothing in OSM to cross-check against.
OSM community field lists 'Unknown / Kootenays' but Golden, BC is in the Columbia-Shuswap / Kootenay Rockies region; may affect directory categorization.
Restaurant is dinner-only (opens at 5 pm daily); touring cyclists seeking lunch service will not be served here — worth noting in the listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established full-service dinner restaurant in Golden with a distinctive log-building setting near the Kicking Horse River; Golden is a major cycling hub and this venue offers a compelling evening meal stop with vegetarian options. Bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed but could be gathered on-site.
enrichment_extras.notes: Sister restaurant The Bear's Den is located on the Trans-Canada Highway in Golden and may warrant a separate OSM/WWC lookup.
